name: Clockwork Coral Reef
description: An underwater reef where coral formations are intricate brass gears and copper polyps, ticking softly with the currents.
prompt: Underwater scene of a vibrant reef composed of mechanical coral: brass gears, copper tubes, and polished steel polyps. Schools of tiny bioluminescent fish swim through the gear teeth. Soft shafts of sunlight pierce the water, highlighting the metallic textures. Hyper‑realistic, macro detail, cool blue‑green palette with warm metal highlights.
caption: Time flows differently beneath the waves ⏱️🐠 #ClockworkReef
